text:
mike: Quick ask — can someone run a short long-ctx (64k) hardware compare across A100/H100/L40S for the new gptx-13b-q4 config? Need p50/p95/p99 and stable throughput for batch=1 and batch=8. Focus on cold vs warm KV cache. No need for full sweep, just a 200-iter run each.
priya: I can kick A100 and H100 tonight. any special flags you want for fairness?
danielle: I can do L40S tomorrow morning. do you want nvlink on for A100?
mike: yes, keep nvlink enabled when available. match memory pinning and disable prefetching. use these commands:
```
# A100 example
bench-run --model=gptx-13b-q4 --device=A100 --ctx=65536 --batch=1 --iters=200 --warm=20 --kv-cache=warm --nvlink=on --out=/tmp/a100_longctx.json
# H100 example
bench-run --model=gptx-13b-q4 --device=H100 --ctx=65536 --batch=1 --iters=200 --warm=20 --kv-cache=warm --out=/tmp/h100_longctx.json
```
priya: got it. i'll mirror those flags for batch=8 too. i'll also add `--mem-frag-check=off` to avoid spurious noise on A100 (that's config we used last month).
oliver: heads-up: watch for kernel fallbacks on H100 with q4, we saw one last week. if that happens, capture `dmesg` and `nvprof` output.
benchbot: scheduled job 2263306 for A100 batch=1 (owner: priya), job 2263307 for H100 batch=1 (owner: priya) — ETA ~45m.
infra-bot: cluster note: A100 rack-7 has live maintenance window at 02:00 UTC, avoid scheduling there after 01:45.
priya: starting A100 run now. will post quick summary when done. :thumbsup:
(45m later) priya: A100 results uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/2263306 — quick summary below.
benchbot: PRELIM RESULTS (200 iters, kv warm)
A100 batch=1: p50=12.3ms, p95=47.8ms, p99=119.7ms, tps=37.9
H100 batch=1: p50=9.1ms, p95=34.7ms, p99=94.8ms, tps=51.7
L40S batch=1 (danielle upload pending): p50~11.2ms, p95~41.6ms, p99~109.6ms, tps~45.2
benchbot: For batch=8 (same run set)
A100 batch=8: p50=18.1ms, p95=82.4ms, p99=210.3ms, tps=121
H100 batch=8: p50=13.2ms, p95=61.0ms, p99=158.9ms, tps=164
notes: H100 gives consistent headroom for throughput; A100 shows higher p99 under microbursts. L40S sits between but closer to A100 on tail.
mike: awesome, can you capture perf counters for the A100 p99 tail next run? suspect L2 thrash on longctx.
danielle: L40S run finished and uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/2263310 — full traces attached. my quick take: L40S tail aligns with A100 when K/V eviction frequency increases.
oliver: re: kernel fallback — didn't see any H100 fallbacks in priya's run. profiling shows higher memory alloc stalls on A100 at iteration ~140.
mike: thanks all. next steps: priya/oliver — re-run A100 with `--kv-size=64G` and collect `perf` counters; danielle — try L40S with `--kv-cache=cold` to capture eviction path. we'll sync results tomorrow morning and decide whether this is a runtime optimization or hardware guidance for routing policies. :eyes:
